title: Design: Part Sale Matrix column shows a rule summary or Same as work orders
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, with Separate Part Sale pricing off.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix B, pricing a new category made for this test, with Separate Part Sale pricing on.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps: 1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A's Part Sale Matrix reads "Same as work orders" in gray.
  • Matrix B's Part Sale Matrix shows its Part Sale rules in short words in the same form as the Work Order Matrix column (for example "2 rules · cost + $, margin"), as in picture 6.2.
